requirements.requirement_text: The members of the group should be national contact points appointed under Article 19(2) of the Directive on electronic commerce (one member per Member State)
requirements.law_title: Commission Decision of 24 October 2005 establishing an expert group on electronic commerce (2005/752/EC)

requirements.requirement_text: Members who are not capable anymore to contribute efficiently to the works of the group, who resign or who do not respect the conditions outlined under Article 3(1) or Article 287 of the Treaty, may be replaced by an alternative Member, for the remaining duration of their mandate
requirements.deadline_text: for the remaining duration of their mandate
requirements.law_title: Commission Decision of 24 October 2005 establishing an expert group on electronic commerce (2005/752/EC)

requirements.requirement_text: The Group shall be chaired by a representative of the Commission
requirements.law_title: Commission Decision of 24 October 2005 establishing an expert group on electronic commerce (2005/752/EC)

requirements.requirement_text: Information obtained during the works of the group or of the sub-groups may not be disseminated if the Commission is of the opinion they are confidential
requirements.law_title: Commission Decision of 24 October 2005 establishing an expert group on electronic commerce (2005/752/EC)

requirements.requirement_text: The expert group on electronic commerce shall adopt agreed rules of procedure on the basis of a model adopted by the Commission
requirements.law_title: Commission Decision of 24 October 2005 establishing an expert group on electronic commerce (2005/752/EC)

requirements.requirement_text: The Group and the sub-groups shall normally meet at the Commission premises, in the form and according to the timetable determined by the Commission
requirements.law_title: Commission Decision of 24 October 2005 establishing an expert group on electronic commerce (2005/752/EC)

requirements.requirement_text: The Secretariat of the Group shall be provided by the Commission
requirements.law_title: Commission Decision of 24 October 2005 establishing an expert group on electronic commerce (2005/752/EC)

requirements.requirement_text: Travel and subsistence expenses incurred by members, observers and experts, in connection with the activities of the Group, shall be reimbursed by the Commission in accordance with the provisions in force within the Commission
requirements.law_title: Commission Decision of 24 October 2005 establishing an expert group on electronic commerce (2005/752/EC)

requirements.requirement_text: Explanations requested by the Commission or accompanying persons pursuant to Article 69(2), points (f) and (g), of Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 shall be given only by authorised representatives or members of staff

requirements.requirement_text: Providers of very large online platforms and very large online search engines must pay annual supervisory fees to the Commission
